hero.subtitle: Comparables with real closing prices, an income factor per census tract and an occupancy adjustment. A valuation that explains every euro — built for investors and agencies.

portals.title: What the listing portals
portals.kicker: A listing tells you what someone is asking. VALIO tells you what the market pays — and why.

closings.title: Closing prices, not asking prices
closings.body: We start from deals that actually closed, not the price a flat first went to market with. In some areas that gap runs into double digits.

why.title: The why behind every adjustment
why.body: Income factor per census tract, occupancy and condition: each correction is broken down with its weight. No black box.

honesty.title: Honest when data is thin
honesty.body: When comparables are scarce, we say so: confidence drops and the range widens. We'd rather admit «not quite sure» than post a falsely precise figure.

features.title: Raw data turned into decisions
features.subtitle: Every valuation ships with its breakdown: you know where the number comes from.

zone.title: Explainable zone income factor
zone.body: We adjust for net income per census tract (INE), not generic postcodes. You see the exact percentage the area adds to or subtracts from the value.

occupancy.title: Occupancy adjustment
occupancy.body: We model the discount for occupancy status —leased, tenanted or vacant— to separate market value from comparison value.

witnesses.title: Comparables from real closings
witnesses.body: Comparables sourced from actual closings and legitimate feeds, with confidence explained. With fewer than six comparables the engine refuses to value rather than invent one.

profit.title: After-tax profitability
profit.body: Estimate the real return on the deal after taxes and costs, so you decide with the figure you actually take home.

pricing.title: Plans that scale with you
pricing.subtitle: No sales call needed to see the price. Here it is.

official.a: No. VALIO provides an indicative, technical valuation to support your decisions. It does not replace the official mortgage appraisal, which is reserved to firms authorised by the Bank of Spain (Order ECO/805/2003).

coverage.q: Which areas do you cover today?
coverage.a: We start with the province of Barcelona and its metropolitan area, and we expand area by area across the rest of Catalonia and Spain.

data.q: Where does the data come from?
data.a: From legitimate sources: net income per census tract from INE, the Cadastre, open data and real closings shared by professionals. Never from scraping listing portals.

leadgen.q: Do you ask for my details or phone number?
leadgen.a: No. We don't run lead generation or chase you with calls. You try the product and decide for yourself, without handing over your phone.

footer.disclaimer: VALIO provides indicative, technical valuations based on comparables and public data. They do not constitute an official appraisal nor replace the report of a valuation firm authorised by the Bank of Spain (Order ECO/805/2003). Results are estimates and are not binding.
